title: 2nd Stopping Place 2nd Truth The Absoluteness Of Dominical Acts 1st Example From Sura Al Nahl

questions.question: Which creature is used in this passage as an example of Allah’s power and wisdom?
questions.answer: The bee.

questions.question: Why does the passage present the bee as something amazing?
questions.answer: Because such a tiny creature is given a very organized design and is able to do an important job with great precision.

questions.question: What kinds of things are placed inside the bee that show careful planning?
questions.answer: It has a built-in plan for its work, it turns what it gathers into sweet food, and it carries a sting with poison that does not harm itself.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the bee’s poison?
questions.answer: It can harm other living creatures, but it does not damage the bee’s own body.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities are needed for making the bee this way?
questions.answer: Great care, knowledge, wisdom, and purpose.

questions.question: Which possible causes are rejected as unable to make the bee and its abilities?
questions.answer: Unaware nature and random accident are rejected.

questions.question: How does the passage use bees all over the earth as evidence?
questions.answer: It says the same wise and balanced design appears in countless bees everywhere at the same time and in the same way.

questions.question: What main belief does the example of the bee support?
questions.answer: It supports the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: Why does the spread of similar bees across the world strengthen the argument?
questions.answer: Because one matching pattern in countless places points to one Maker, not many separate causes.

questions.question: Which Qur’anic example is explained in this passage?
questions.answer: The example of the bee and how it is guided to make its home.

questions.question: How is the bee described in relation to honey?
questions.answer: It is described like a tiny producer of honey.

questions.question: What does the passage say is written into the bee’s small head?
questions.answer: A full plan for carrying out its duty.

questions.question: What process inside the bee is mentioned as a sign of design?
questions.answer: Delicious food is prepared and matured inside its very small body.

questions.question: Why is the bee’s sting especially important in the argument?
questions.answer: Because it contains deadly poison yet does not injure the bee itself, showing precise control.

questions.question: What conclusion is drawn from the order and balance seen in bees?
questions.answer: That such things cannot come from blind, messy, or accidental causes.

questions.question: What repeated features in bees around the world are highlighted?
questions.answer: The same wisdom, carefulness, balance, and pattern are seen in countless bees everywhere.

questions.question: What final lesson should a student take from this example?
questions.answer: The bee points clearly to Allah’s unity through its design and the worldwide sameness of that design.

questions.question: What is the first main example discussed in the target passage?
questions.answer: The bee.

questions.question: In the passage, what does the bee’s natural role show about creation?
questions.answer: It shows that even a tiny creature is made with purpose and careful arrangement.

questions.question: What three amazing features of the bee are mentioned?
questions.answer: Its work plan, its making of sweet food, and its poisonous sting that does not hurt itself.

questions.question: How does the passage connect these features to knowledge and wisdom?
questions.answer: It says such features need deep knowledge, careful intention, and wise arrangement.

questions.question: Why are chance and nature said to have no share in this matter?
questions.answer: Because they are described as lacking awareness, order, and balance, while the bee shows all three.

questions.question: What does the phrase about bees being scattered across the earth add to the meaning?
questions.answer: It shows that this is not one unusual case but a worldwide pattern.

questions.question: What is the significance of the bee being made in the same way everywhere?
questions.answer: It points to one Creator acting with one wisdom and one will.

questions.question: Is the proof based only on the bee’s existence, or also on how many bees there are and how they are alike?
questions.answer: It is based on both the bee itself and the countless similar bees found across the world.

questions.question: What central Islamic belief is proved by this example according to the passage?
questions.answer: Tawhid, the unity of Allah.

questions.question: What living thing does the passage focus on to teach a lesson about faith?
questions.answer: It focuses on the bee.

questions.question: Why does the passage call the bee a sign of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because its tiny body carries out great and complex tasks in a perfectly arranged way.

questions.question: What does the bee’s small size add to the argument?
questions.answer: It makes the design even more amazing, since so much function is placed into something so small.

questions.question: What kind of food does the passage say is produced within the bee?
questions.answer: Very sweet and delicious nourishment.

questions.question: What unusual combination in the bee shows precise creation?
questions.answer: It has harmful poison in its sting, yet that poison does not harm the bee itself.

questions.question: What character traits of creation are seen in the bee according to the passage?
questions.answer: Order, balance, wisdom, and purpose.

questions.question: What idea is being challenged when the passage mentions accident and nature?
questions.answer: The idea that the bee came to be through blind or random causes.

questions.question: How does the large number of bees help prove the main point?
questions.answer: The same careful design appearing in countless bees across the earth shows one Lord’s action.

questions.question: What is the final result of thinking about the bee in the way this passage teaches?
questions.answer: A person sees a clear proof of Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Which animal is used as the first proof in this passage?
questions.answer: The bee.

questions.question: What job of the bee is emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Its important task for which it has been specially equipped.

questions.question: What does the passage say is placed in the bee’s head?
questions.answer: A complete built-in program for doing its work.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens in the bee’s stomach?
questions.answer: Sweet nourishment is prepared and brought to completion there.

questions.question: How does the sting become part of the proof of design?
questions.answer: It carries poison strong enough to kill, yet it does not injure the bee that carries it.

questions.question: What does the passage say would be necessary for making the bee in this way?
questions.answer: Very high care, knowledge, wisdom, and deliberate purpose.

questions.question: Why can disorderly causes not explain the bee?
questions.answer: Because the bee shows exact balance and arrangement, which disorder cannot produce.

questions.question: What does the passage say about bees in many different places?
questions.answer: Countless bees across the world display the same design, care, and order.

questions.question: What belief does this worldwide pattern point to?
questions.answer: It points to the unity of Allah.

questions.question: What is the subject of the “first” example in the target passage?
questions.answer: The bee.

questions.question: How does the passage show that the bee is not an ordinary small insect?
questions.answer: It presents the bee as a remarkable work of power with a complex task and carefully arranged features.

questions.question: What built-in guidance does the bee have according to the passage?
questions.answer: It has an internal plan that directs it in carrying out its duty.

questions.question: What two opposite-seeming things inside the bee are mentioned together?
questions.answer: Sweet food and deadly poison.

questions.question: Why is it important that the poison does not hurt the bee?
questions.answer: It shows fine control and wise design, not careless or random formation.

questions.question: What kinds of causes are described as unable to take part in making the bee this way?
questions.answer: Causes that are blind, disorderly, unbalanced, and accidental.

questions.question: Besides the bee’s individual design, what larger pattern is used as proof?
questions.answer: The same design is seen in countless bees spread throughout the earth.

questions.question: What does “same wisdom, same care, same symmetry” suggest about the maker of bees?
questions.answer: It suggests one Creator with one knowledge and one method.

questions.question: What is the passage trying to make the reader understand through the example of the bee?
questions.answer: That the bee is a clear sign of Allah’s oneness.
